skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the general concepts, characteristics, and role of international investment in national economies.
Identify various forms of international investment currently in use.
Analyze the impact of the international investment environment on investment flows.

Understand the basics of international investment liberalization and the development of cross-border investment activities with the formation of free investment zones and the emergence of numerous bilateral, multilateral, and plurilateral investment agreements.
Explain the nature, operating mechanisms, and investment strategies of multinational companies and their role in expanding international investment activities globally.
Understand the nature, forms, and consequences of transfer pricing in international investment and propose solutions to combat transfer pricing in international investment activities.
